name: AutoGDBot Realtime
description: Realtime long-horizon native rollouts, coordinate-based takeoff timing and independently replayed control prefixes.

enabled.name: Autopilot
enabled.description: Realtime rolling-horizon control with native physics verification.

budget-ms.name: Search time budget (ms)
budget-ms.description: Native work is limited to at most 2 ms per physics command; individual native calls cannot be interrupted.

telemetry.name: Save timing CSV
telemetry.description: Writes telemetry in the mod save directory every 256 physics ticks.

debug-traces.name: Show candidate traces
debug-traces.description: Show diagnostic alternatives, geometry boxes and expanded telemetry.

lookahead-seconds.name: Lookahead time (seconds)
lookahead-seconds.description: Target forecast distance. Actual native depth depends on geometry and the per-step time budget.

trace-fps.name: Trace refresh rate
trace-fps.description: Refreshes exact native path samples at the render frame rate, up to this limit.
